text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Joel Pitt said Monday he maintained a buy rating on computer disk drive maker Quantum Corp.

-- said that Quantum told him at a company visit last week that revenues for the quarter would be back-ended because of desktop product transitions. Said that although this is consistent with what Quantum has said before, it might cause investor concern.
-- said unconfirmed reports of high drive inventories in the channel may have hurt Quantum's stock price last week. Said that Quantum said its channel inventories were in line with its plan.
-- said the company's digital linear tape business could see revenue growth of 100 percent in the June quarter compared with the year-ago quarter.
